subject: mathematics
concept: Measuring angles in degrees using a protractor
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student aligns a virtual protractor to a drawn angle and reads the degree measure
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a pictured protractor placement and states the angle measure
exercise.abstract: Student estimates and then measures given angles in degrees

misconception_flags: reads the wrong scale on the protractor (inner vs outer)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
